mira-newhire: quick new-hire question 4 Notion search isn't returning our infra runbooks for me. I can open the direct link, but search and filters don't surface them. Also, how do I 'favorite' pages so they're easier to find?

devex-sam: welcome! two things to check quickly: 1) Make sure the runbooks have relevant page properties (Tags, Owner, Status). Notion search weights multi-select properties and page titles more heavily than plain text. 2) Make sure you're in the right workspace and that the pages are not restricted (Restricted pages sometimes don't show in global search).

mira-newhire: the runbook does have Tags but they're single-line text fields. Should those be multi-select?

devex-sam: yes4change Tags to a Multi-select property when proposing templates/runbooks. Also add a slug property (example: eng-infra/service-runbook) and set Status: Published. That helps our internal search sync and the docs indexer.

ops-jen: for favorites: open the page and click "Add to Favorites" (star icon) or add a workspace shortcut using "Add to sidebar". New hires sometimes miss the sidebar because they need to expand the Team Docs section. Also hit the "Follow" button to get notifications on changes.

mira-newhire: if I change the property types, will that break the template or links?

devex-sam: changing property types can be done safely on drafts. For live templates we prefer maintainers to apply property schema changes during publication so the template button metadata stays consistent. If it's just your draft in My Pages, go ahead and convert Tags -> Multi-select.

search-bot: Index note: A reindex is recommended after property schema changes. To request an index refresh run: `@docs-bot reindex https://redwood.notion.so/your-page-link` in this channel.

docs-bot: Action logged: reindex request pending for https://redwood.notion.so/eng-infra/runbook by mira-newhire. Ticket DOCS-621 created.

mira-newhire: thanks! I'll update Tags to multi-select, add Status and slug, favorite the page, and ping the bot. Appreciate the quick help :smile:
